ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-gray) base with high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters comprising approximately 12-15% of the total surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-toned field with distinct, high-contrast white circular rings (rosettes) and linear vectors (scratches) mapped non-uniformly across the X-Y coordinates of both fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees and a vertical depth reaching the medial convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-amplitude peaks and valleys; notable deep serrations on the right lobe and a severely jagged, irregular termination on the distal left lobe tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves sweeping upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal tips, characterized by a steep upward gradient on the upper margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely populated clusters of white circular pixel rings (5-20 pixel diameter) scattered across the ventral plane, with high concentrations on the central and right lobe regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) intersecting across the dark pigment, particularly a prominent 'star' shaped intersection on the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe structural disruption and brownish/reddish-toned organic protrusion at the distal tip of the left fluke lobe, indicating significant physical trauma or recent tissue exposure.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly complex and dense network of criss-crossing linear abrasions on the lower-medial section of the left lobe forming a distinct high-contrast geometric pattern.
